people.name: Kasey Johnson
people.headline: Marketing & Events at Bright Data
people.noteText: Marketing and events. Discussed marketing events and job opportunities. Kasey is a marketing professional at Bright Data with experience in marketing and community events. A useful contact for future AI events and professional networking.

people.name: Lizz Zhang
people.headline: Developer Relations at FalkorDB
people.noteText: FalkorDB and deployment. Discussed moving a project from a local environment to the cloud and the differences involved. Also exchanged feedback about SDK scripts versus API usage. Follow up on FalkorDB integration, deployment options, and developer experience.

people.name: Nancy Li
people.headline: Community Organizer & Tech Events
people.noteText: Community and event organizing. Energetic and helpful, with a strong interest in organizing community events around causes such as water and food. A good connection for future community initiatives and tech events.

people.name: Neil Ricci
people.headline: Solutions Engineer at Bright Data
people.noteText: Bright Data and web scraping. Helped us understand Bright Data usage for web scraping, including LinkedIn limitations and UI bugs we encountered. A valuable technical contact for troubleshooting scraping workflows and web data access.

people.name: Kunal Kushwaha
people.headline: Developer Advocate at Qodo
people.noteText: Event hosting and Qodo sponsorship. Came from Amsterdam and brought great energy despite the travel and potential jet lag. Helped welcome participants, distribute codes, and support the Qodo sponsor activities. A memorable and energetic presence at the event.

people.name: Joshua Levy
people.headline: Multi-Agent Architecture & AI Systems
people.noteText: Agent-to-agent communication. Discussed the idea of agents communicating and collaborating directly with other agents. Follow up on multi-agent architecture, agent handoffs, shared context, and practical agent-to-agent workflows.

people.name: Sidra Miconi
people.headline: Founder at AgentGlass
people.noteText: AgentGlass founder. Founder of AgentGlass, focused on AI agent reliability and evaluation. A relevant connection for discussions about agent quality, testing, evaluation, and production readiness.

people.name: Mannan Shukla
people.headline: Founder at Spawnpoint
people.noteText: Developer tools and deployment. Discussed the idea of bringing the tools a team builds together in one place. His profile highlights cloud-native engineering and Spawnpoint, a tool designed to help developers deploy software to the cloud through coding agents and MCP.

people.name: Claudio Olmedo
people.headline: Founder at One Dollar Computer
people.noteText: One Dollar Computer and robotics. Discussed One Dollar Computer and robotics. His work focuses on making computing and STEM education more accessible. Follow up on low-cost computing, robotics, and hands-on technology education.

people.name: Aarsh Sheth
people.headline: Backend & Distributed Systems Engineer
people.noteText: Backend and distributed systems. Discussed backend engineering and distributed systems. A potential contact for exchanging ideas on scalable architectures, backend services, and infrastructure for AI applications.

people.name: Shesha Sai Kumar Reddy Sadu
people.headline: Geospatial & Data Engineering Specialist
people.noteText: Geospatial and data expertise. Introduced as a geospatial specialist. Worth reconnecting to learn more about his work in geospatial technologies and explore potential overlap with AI and data-driven applications.

people.name: Madhu Koseke
people.headline: Senior Data Engineer
people.noteText: Teammate and senior data engineer. Useful professional connection for exchanging ideas on data engineering, platforms, and AI projects. His profile describes a focus on data platforms.

people.name: Madhughnea Adabala
people.headline: UX & Backend Engineer
people.noteText: Teammate and UX. A teammate with a UX focus. Useful to collaborate with on improving user experience, product workflows, and the interface for AI-powered applications.

people.name: Abhinav R Bharadwaj
people.headline: Full-Stack & AI Engineer at Regilient
people.noteText: Full-stack and AI application development. Software engineer at Regilient, with experience in Python, the MERN stack, full-stack development, and AI applications.
